parameters.name: AppType
parameters.description:
The type of application. Valid values:

*   `TRACE`: Application Monitoring
*   `EBPF`: Application Monitoring eBPF Edition

parameters.name: AppVersion
parameters.description: The application version. 1: Basic version, 2: Professional version.

parameters.name: EnableLog
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable logging. Valid values:

*   `true`: enabled
*   `false`: disabled

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: MonitorConfigJson
parameters.description: The configuration of the alert. The value is a JSON string. For more information about this parameter, see **Additional information about request parameters**.

parameters.name: MonitorContactsJson
parameters.description: The configuration of alert contacts. The value is a JSON string.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: This parameter is not supported. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ScheduleBusyWorkers
parameters.description: Specifies whether to schedule a busy worker.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 create-app-group --app-name DocTest --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id TestSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --description Test --max-jobs 1000 --namespace-name Test --app-key adcExHZviLcl0000 --monitor-config-json sendChannel_:_ding,sms,mail,phone_,_alarmType_:_Contacts_,_webhookIsAtAll_:_false --monitor-contacts-json name_:_Alice_Johnson_,_name_:_Lee_Smith --schedule-busy-workers false --enable-log true --app-type 1 --app-version 2 --notification-policy-name test-workday-notification --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 CreateAppGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Description Test --MonitorContactsJson 'name_:_Alice_Johnson_,_name_:_Lee_Smith' --EnableLog true --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --AppName DocTest --GroupId 'TestSchedulerx.defaultGroup' --AppVersion 2 --NamespaceName Test --MonitorConfigJson 'sendChannel_:_ding,sms,mail,phone_,_alarmType_:_Contacts_,_webhookIsAtAll_:_false' --AppKey adcExHZviLcl0000 --NamespaceSource schedulerx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NotificationPolicyName 'test-workday-notification' --AppType 1 --MaxJobs 1000 --ScheduleBusyWorkers false
